title: Best AI Meeting Transcription Tools 2026: Tested Picks & Real-World Reviews
description: Compare the best AI meeting transcription tools of 2026 - Otter, Fireflies, Read AI, tl;dv, Fathom, Granola - with verified pricing, CRM integrations and free tiers.
short_desc: Otter, Fireflies, Read AI, tl;dv and Fathom ranked on 2026 pricing, transcription quality and CRM write-back.
tldr_pick: Otter Pro at $8.33/user/month is the best pick for most teams in 2026. Real-time transcription quality is best-in-class, OtterPilot joins the call itself and answers questions in chat, and the Salesforce/HubSpot/Slack write-back covers most teams' needs. Three clear exceptions push you elsewhere: Fireflies for CRM write-back depth, Read AI for coaching analytics, and Fathom Free if you only need unlimited minutes with no CRM.
key_takeaways: Otter is the best pick for most teams - $8.33/user/mo annual, real-time transcription, OtterPilot join-the-call, CRM write-back.
Fireflies wins on CRM write-back depth - AskFred conversational search across past meetings is unique.
Fathom Free has truly unlimited minutes - the best free option for solo operators.
tl;dv owns clip sharing and multi-language support (30+ languages) for async-first teams.
who_for: Anyone running 5+ meetings per week who needs accurate transcription, AI summaries, and integration with their existing workflow (CRM, Slack, project management). Solo operators and small teams should start with Fathom Free; sales and customer-success teams should start with Fireflies; teams that want best-in-class real-time transcription should start with Otter.
methodology: We aggregated 2026 reporting from ToolChase's Otter-versus-Fireflies-versus-tldv roundup, Versusmatrix's three-way comparison, Postorycafe's five-tool study and Nesyona's Otter-alternatives feature matrix, then cross-referenced every plan tier and transcription quota against each vendor's live pricing page. Where reviewers disagreed on speaker-identification accuracy or CRM integration depth we note both the consensus and the outlier. This is an editorial roundup, not a hands-on benchmark - every platform here has a free tier or trial so you can validate fit on your own call volume. Pricing verified August 2026.

faq.q: What is the best AI meeting transcription tool in 2026?
faq.a: Otter Pro at $8.33/user/month annual billing for most teams. Real-time transcription quality is the best in category, the OtterPilot join-the-call feature is genuinely useful, and one bill covers the recording + summarisation + CRM write-back that most teams need. Fireflies Business at $29/user/month is the right call when CRM write-back depth drives the decision.

faq.q: Is there a good free AI meeting transcription tool?
faq.a: Fathom Free is the strongest free option in 2026 with truly unlimited recording minutes, unlimited storage, and full AI summaries. Otter Free has a 300 min/month cap, which most teams exceed inside the first two weeks. tl;dv Free has unlimited recording but caps AI features.

faq.q: How much does Otter.ai cost in 2026?
faq.a: Otter has four published tiers: Free (300 min/mo), Pro at $8.33/user/mo on annual billing or $16.99/user/mo monthly, Business at $20/user/mo, and Enterprise custom. The Pro tier unlocks Otter AI Chat, action items and most integrations; Business adds OtterPilot and CRM write-back.

faq.q: Which meeting AI tool is best for Salesforce?
faq.a: Fireflies Business at $29/user/month. It supports custom field mapping into Salesforce, including opportunity stage updates, next-step notes and contact-level summaries. Otter Business also writes to Salesforce but with less granular control.

faq.q: Do AI meeting tools work for languages other than English?
faq.a: Yes - tl;dv supports 30+ languages and is the strongest multilingual option in 2026. Otter and Fireflies both handle English-first workflows with limited support for Spanish, French, German and a handful of other languages. For non-English primary teams, tl;dv is the safer pick.

products.name: Otter.ai
products.best_for: Real-time meeting transcription with built-in AI summaries
products.summary: Otter remains the category default in 2026: real-time transcription during Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams calls, speaker identification, post-call AI summaries, and action-item extraction that writes back to Slack, HubSpot and Salesforce. The 2026 release added OtterPilot - the assistant joins the call itself and answers questions in chat - and the Business tier's transcript quota now covers most teams' weekly volume. For teams that want one tool that records, transcribes, summarises and integrates with a CRM, Otter is still the answer.
pros: Largest installed base and the most polished Zoom-native UX
OtterPilot joins the call itself and answers questions in chat
Salesforce, HubSpot and Slack integrations write notes back to the CRM
cons: Transcription minute caps on Pro tier are easy to exceed
Speaker identification accuracy dips on calls with more than 8 participants
Free tier recordings auto-delete after a few months

products.name: Fireflies.ai
products.badge: Best for sales teams and CRM
products.best_for: Sales and customer-success teams that need deep CRM write-back
products.summary: Fireflies is the meeting assistant that wins on integration depth: it sends structured notes and action items to Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho and Slack with custom field mapping, which is why most sales-led organisations end up here. The 2026 release added AskFred - a conversational layer that lets you query every meeting you've ever had - and a sentiment score that flags calls where the customer tone shifted negative. Less polished than Otter for real-time transcription but stronger on the post-call workflow.
pros: Deepest CRM write-back of any tool in this list - custom field mapping included
AskFred conversational search across every past meeting is genuinely useful
Sentiment score surfaces mid-call tone shifts that humans miss
cons: Live transcription quality trails Otter by a measurable margin in 2026 reviews
Pro tier is $18/user/mo vs Otter's $8.33 - more expensive for small teams
UX feels more enterprise than consumer; not the cleanest for first-time users

products.name: Read AI
products.best_for: Coaching-heavy teams that want per-speaker engagement scores
products.summary: Read AI takes a different angle: instead of just transcribing, it scores every participant on engagement, sentiment, talk-time ratio and filler-word use, then produces a 'meeting health' report. Useful for managers coaching a sales or CS team, less useful if you only need a transcript and a summary. The 2026 release added Coachable AI that flags missed cues ('you said um 47 times') and a per-meeting influence score that ranks how much each attendee drove the conversation.
pros: Per-speaker engagement and influence scores are unique to Read
Coachable AI surfaces specific moments to improve (filler words, missed cues)
Free tier includes 5 meetings/month - enough to evaluate
cons: Engagement analytics feel intrusive to most users on first encounter
Not a strong fit if you only need clean transcripts - the value prop is the coaching data
CRM integrations trail Fireflies for depth and reliability

products.name: tl;dv
products.best_for: Async-first teams that want shareable meeting clips
products.summary: tl;dv is the pick when the question is 'I need to share a 4-minute clip from a 60-minute call with my team'. Its editor trims transcripts into timestamped video clips with one click, then publishes them to a shareable link or to Notion, Slack or a project-management tool. Multi-language support covers 30+ languages. Less deep on CRM write-back than Fireflies, but the clip-sharing workflow is the best in category.
pros: Clip editor turns 60-minute transcripts into 4-minute shareable clips
Multi-language transcription (30+ languages) is the best in the category
Free tier has no recording limit - just pay for AI features
cons: CRM write-back is shallow compared to Fireflies or Otter
Real-time transcription quality is good but not best-in-class
No native video coaching or engagement analytics

products.name: Fathom
products.best_for: Solo operators and small teams that want a strong free tier
products.summary: Fathom is the strongest free meeting transcription tool in 2026: unlimited recording minutes, unlimited storage, full AI summaries and action-item extraction, no cap on calls per month. The trade-off is no CRM write-back at the free tier and no team-wide analytics. The Team tier adds Salesforce, HubSpot and Slack integrations plus shared templates, and it costs less than Otter's Pro per seat. If you are a solo operator or a small team that wants a real free tier, Fathom is the clear pick.
pros: Genuinely unlimited free tier with full AI summaries - no minute caps
Team tier ($24/user/mo) is cheaper than Otter Pro for most small teams
Action-item extraction quality is among the best in the category
cons: No CRM write-back at free tier - you need Team ($24/user/mo) for Salesforce/HubSpot
Speaker identification accuracy dips on calls with crosstalk or poor audio
No native engagement analytics or coaching features

products.name: Granola
products.best_for: Teams that want AI-edited notes, not raw transcripts
products.summary: Granola takes a different approach: it does NOT produce a verbatim transcript by default. Instead it listens during the call and produces an AI-edited summary in your voice and structure, which most users prefer if they only need notes to act on (not a record). The trade-off: no searchable archive of what was actually said. Skip Granola unless you specifically want notes, not transcripts.
pros: AI-edited notes in your voice/structure are easier to read than raw transcripts
Best UX for users who hate reading transcripts but want meeting records
Works with on-device audio for privacy-sensitive calls
cons: No raw transcript by default - you cannot search what was actually said
Free tier limits the number of meetings per month
Less useful for legal/compliance use cases that need verbatim records
